description: Ideate (F228; framework .planning/research/bmuz-vision/stages.md): gather the material — the loose idea, captured. Show me what you have (all of it read, Google Drive too); the game so far written back per need (fixed · ideas · open); a few gap questions, gather mode only, frame first; then the game so far, version 2, with the open questions that matter most. Nothing is chosen here and no research runs by default; Define comes next.

steps.description: Show me what you have: the idea in one breath, and every file, folder or Drive link
Reading it all: the text of everything shared (files, folders, Drive), and what the rest appears to be
Sorting it: what's fixed, the ideas and what's open, for each thing a game needs (nothing asked)
The game so far, version 1: what you shared, per need (your quotes checked against your words)
The gaps: a few questions at a time, the costliest first (frame first), each saying which gap it fills
The game so far, version 2: saved in .planning/IDEATE.md (shelves only grow) with the open questions that matter most
